workflow: A cache lookup traverses entries and invokes user-controlled equality logic for each candidate.
The equality callback re-enters cache management and removes the entry currently being examined.
The original lookup resumes with its previously retained pointer, assuming the entry remains valid.
Subsequent cache reordering or value retrieval dereferences the released entry, causing a use-after-free and process termination.
summary: Reentrant cache mutation invalidates an entry during lookup
decision_reason: The failure workflow is materially the same as re-entrant cleanup invalidating container state while the original operation continues using an address captured before the re-entrant mutation.
